Container.Name: ATHENA
Container.Overview: ATHENA unified private family assistant with the embedded router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI LLM brain. One GHCR package and one Unraid container. The CLIProxyAPI management panel connects Claude, Codex/OpenAI, Gemini and Grok accounts; ATHENA discovers their available models dynamically and selects the appropriate LLM internally; users do not choose a model.
Container.Requires: For a private GHCR package, configure GHCR credentials in Unraid before pulling. Open ATHENA first, create the administrator, then use ATHENA → LLM Router to obtain the generated management key and open the CLIProxyAPI panel.

Config.Name: CLIProxyAPI Management
Config.Description: Embedded router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI management and OpenAI-compatible API

Config.Name: Persistent Configuration
Config.Description: Database, encrypted vault, CLIProxyAPI config/auths/logs, models, releases and master key

Config.Name: Project Files
Config.Description: Existing share with song lyrics/storyboards/screenplays/reference files. ATHENA can read freely; every write (new file, new folder, move/organize, saving an approved image) requires your confirmation in Actions first — nothing here is touched automatically.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Optional external HTTPS URL used for ATHENA OAuth callbacks. It can also be entered later from the ATHENA web page.

Config.Name: Secure Session Cookie
Config.Description: Set to 1 only when ATHENA is served through HTTPS.

Config.Name: Trusted Reverse Proxy IPs
Config.Description: Comma-separated reverse proxy IPs allowed to provide forwarded headers.
